name: Chongqing Millison Technologies INC.
summary: Chongqing Millison Technologies INC. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precision aluminum alloy die-casting parts for the automotive, telecommunications, and energy storage sectors in China and internationally. The company's products in the communications field include structural parts, such as 4G, 5G, and 5G-A communication base station bodies, and shielding covers; and products in the automotive field comprise engine, transmission, steering, and body systems of traditional vehicles, as well as electric drive systems, electronic control systems, battery systems, body systems, thermal management runner plates, and cold plates of new energy vehicle products.
